guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: aggressive dry indie crunch with bright upper-mid bite
tone.profile: aggressive dry indie crunch with bright upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a Green OD for initial grit and boost, followed by the UK 45 amp model to capture the Plexi-style punch. The US Vintage 2x12 cab provides necessary upper-mid clarity, complemented by EQ adjustments for aggressive articulation.
corrections: replace generic mid-gain with drier, harsher attack
lean more into fuzz bite than Tube Screamer polish
